label: Qwen 8B
summary: This breaks nearly every rule they care about: card-per-item layout, explanatory hero text, multi-line tall rows, bold/colored mixed typography, emoji decorations everywhere, and a large hero banner consuming vertical space before the actual content.

fixes.issue: Card-per-item layout with bordered boxes for each session, multi-line tall rows
fixes.fix: Replace the 3-column card grid with a flat pseudo-table: one row per session, single-line height, columns for title/project/agent/model/timestamp/status, no borders per item, just alternating row backgrounds or a simple divider line.

fixes.issue: Large decorative hero banner with explanatory prose ('Every coding-agent session, beautifully organized and instantly searchable!')
fixes.fix: Remove the hero section entirely. Start the page with the filter bar and table immediately. Move search inline with the filters.

fixes.issue: Mixed bold labels inline with values ('Project: relay-web', 'Agent: Claude Code') and emoji decorations throughout
fixes.fix: Remove all emoji icons and bold label prefixes. In the table layout, each column header labels the data; cell values are plain uniform-weight text.

fixes.issue: Stat cards with large colored numbers and emoji icons above the session list add decorative chrome and vertical waste
fixes.fix: Remove the stat cards or collapse them into a single compact status-count line (e.g. '17 sessions · 11 completed · 4 failed · 1 running') above the filter row.

label: Qwen 8B + skill
summary: Cards with borders around each row, multi-line row height, explanatory subtitle text, and mixed label weights/colors all violate their core rules.

fixes.issue: Each session is a tall bordered card with two lines of content — violates both the card-UI rule and the compact single-line row rule
fixes.fix: Replace cards with a flat table layout: one row per session, columns for status, title, project, agent, model, timestamp, action — all on a single line with ~32px row height and a bottom border only (no box per row)

fixes.issue: 'Browse and search the history of your coding-agent sessions.' is explanatory prose text under the heading
fixes.fix: Remove the subtitle entirely; the page heading 'Recent Sessions' is sufficient

fixes.issue: Row metadata uses mixed ALL-CAPS label spans (PROJECT, AGENT, MODEL, STARTED) inline with values, creating visual noise and exposing internal structure
fixes.fix: Remove the label prefixes; rely on column headers in the table layout to identify each field

fixes.issue: Filter bar is a large bordered box with excessive padding, adding vertical bulk
fixes.fix: Render filters as a compact inline row of small pill/tab controls flush with the table header, no surrounding box

label: Qwen 8B + GEPA
summary: The table layout and compact rows are on the right track, but the stat cards, bold session titles mixed with plain text, color-coded status badges, chevron arrows on every row, and the descriptive subtitle all violate their explicit avoid rules.

fixes.issue: Four bordered stat cards (TOTAL SESSIONS, COMPLETED, FAILED, RUNNING) are card/box UI for summary data — they add decorative chrome and expose internal sub-scores
fixes.fix: Remove the stat cards entirely; the count info is redundant with the table itself

fixes.issue: Session title column uses bold weight while all other columns use normal weight — mixed typography within the same content region
fixes.fix: Set all row cells to the same font-weight (normal/400); rely on column position, not bold, to distinguish the title

fixes.issue: Arrow chevrons (→) on every row are decorative navigational chrome explicitly called out as unwanted
fixes.fix: Remove the → icons; make the entire row clickable with a subtle hover highlight instead

fixes.issue: Descriptive subtitle '17 sessions across 5 projects' under the page heading is explanatory prose

label: Post-trained Qwen 8B
sub: Weights updated with your grader as reward
summary: Clean, compact flat-table layout with good column structure — a few small violations around the status dot+color mixing and the footer prose line hold it back.

fixes.issue: Footer 'Showing all 17 sessions from the last 7 days' is explanatory prose text in the UI
fixes.fix: Remove the footer sentence entirely; the count '17 this week' in the header already conveys this

fixes.issue: Status column mixes colored dots and colored text labels (blue 'Running', red 'Failed', amber 'Needs review') — non-uniform typography with color-coded inline text
fixes.fix: Use a single muted dot indicator only, no colored text; keep status label text in uniform gray weight matching other columns

fixes.issue: Model column uses monospace styling that may jut out from surrounding text
fixes.fix: Render model names in the same sans-serif as other columns at the same size and weight, no code formatting
